text:
maria (ml-eng): kicking off Ivy customer LoRA onboarding. attaching quick-eval results in thread. running sparse-0.7 LoRA + per-channel int3 quant. goal: keep amount extraction / formatting exact for invoices.
aj (applied-ml): nice — are we running shadow-roll on prod traffic or synthetic? :eyes:
maria (ml-eng): shadow on 5% prod + 1000-case eval pack (Ivy-invoice-suite). quick smoke now.
shadowbot: shadow-roll started: policy=5% route=prod-eu, model=redwood-4x-lora-sparse70-int3, run_id=sr-2026-03-22-001
sean (qa): can you paste the eval command you used? I'll run locally with my extended tests.
maria (ml-eng): local command:
```
python eval_pack.py --model redwood-4x-lora-sparse70-int3 --dataset ivy_invoice_quickpack.json --metrics amount_f1,format_accuracy,latency_p50
```
results snippet:
```
{"amount_f1": "0.942", "format_accuracy": "0.88", "latency_p50_ms": "82"}
```
nora (solutions): format_accuracy at 0.88 is concerning — Ivy requires exact currency and two-decimal formatting. baseline (redwood-4x) was 0.985, right?
aj (applied-ml): baseline numbers from last week: amount_f1=0.971, format_accuracy=0.987, p50=94ms. Sparse+int3 improved latency but regressed formatting.
maria (ml-eng): digging in — quick diff shows model sometimes strips trailing zeros when parsing tokens crossing LoRA-grafted attention heads. example: "$1,000.00" -> "$1,000" or "$1000.0" in generated invoice fields.
sean (qa): attaching failing examples from quickpack: case ids 17, 402, 889 — all amounts with trailing ".00" or localized separators.
shadowbot: shadow-roll traffic results (first 10k requests): 5xx=0, latency tail small improvement, but format_mismatch_rate=0.12 vs baseline 0.01.
nora (solutions): recommend immediate mitigations: 1) fallback policy for amount-sensitive routes, 2) patch LoRA merge (reduce sparsity from 0.7->0.55) and re-quantize, 3) add token-preserve postprocess as temporary guard. thoughts?
aj (applied-ml): agree. also want to test grafting LoRA only on feed-forward layers (not on LayerNorm) — maybe LayerNorm interactions are causing tokenization blending.
maria (ml-eng): plan: roll patch to dev with sparsity=0.55 and filter LoRA to FF layers only, re-run quickpack + shadow-run on 2% traffic. deploy-bot can you schedule a canary?
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: env=dev->staging->prod-shadow, percent=2, start=2026-03-22T15:42:00Z, rollback_on=format_accuracy<0.95 or amount_f1<0.96
sean (qa): I'll run extended locale tests (comma vs period separators, trailing zeros, currency symbols) once patch is built. can you drop the new model artifact to s3?
maria (ml-eng): uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/ivy/redwood-4x-lora-sparse55-ff-only-int3.tar.gz. SHA256: 3b7f1a...
aj (applied-ml): quick note: when re-quantizing, use per-channel scaling with symmetric zero-point — past runs preserved formatting better.
maria (ml-eng): good call, will use that quant config. re-run command now and post results.
```
# re-quantize quick run
quantize --model orig.pt --out model-int3.pq --method per-channel --sym true
python eval_pack.py --model model-int3.pq --dataset ivy_invoice_quickpack.json
```
new results:
```
{"amount_f1": "0.964", "format_accuracy": "0.956", "latency_p50_ms": "78"}
```
nora (solutions): nice — format_accuracy 0.956 meets our rollback threshold but still slightly below baseline. with postprocess token-preserve we can ship and monitor.
sean (qa): I'll add 2 more checks to CI: exact-match for formatted_amount and regex for decimals. will raise a blocker if any fail.
aj (applied-ml): log a note in the rollout: "LoRA graft applied to FF-only, sparsity 55%, per-channel int3 symmetric quant; fallback route enabled for amount-sensitive endpoints."
maria (ml-eng): logging now in the rollout doc + PR. final ask: assign someone to monitor shadow metrics for first 24h and watch format_mismatch_rate, amount_f1, and p99 latency. @nora?
nora (solutions): happy to monitor. will set up alert: format_mismatch_rate > 0.03 -> pager.
maria (ml-eng): thanks team. follow-ups: (1) evaluate long-context KB caching interaction (Ivy uses 4k prompts) (2) run additional locale packs (de, fr) (3) check KV-cache warmstart offsets after LoRA graft. I'll open threads for each. :white_check_mark:
